_comment: Allowed shell commands for bridge-side approval auto-decide (GitHub-opened sessions). SERVER-SIDE ONLY: this file is read by the bridge process, schema-validated on load, and never sent to the browser over WS. Edit with care: every `allow` entry lets matching agent commands run without a human prompt.
_semantics: allow: regexes matched from the command start (re.match). A command auto-passes when ANY allow entry matches AND NO deny rule matches. deny: entries scope regexes (re.search) to leading command names; an entry without `commands` applies to every allowed command.

deny.comment: find stays inspection-only: -delete/-exec would smuggle writes past the allowlist.
Destructive git forms keep prompting a human: discarded work is unrecoverable.
